duration.a: 60–90 minutes on site. The full report with photos and video evidence is delivered in the app within 24 hours of the visit.

how_it_works.a: A certified inspector visits the car and runs a 60-point check: engine, suspension, body, electrics, accident history, paint thickness on every panel, OBD-II scan. Every issue is photographed. The full report lands in your app within 24 hours.

inspectors.a: Only certified specialists with 5+ years of experience. All pass document verification, hold professional credentials (TÜV / DEKRA or equivalent) and carry liability insurance. You see their rating and real customer reviews.

what_we_photograph.a: VIN, odometer, body from 8 angles, paint thickness per panel, tyres, wheels, brakes, suspension, engine bay, interior, OBD-II screen with codes. Every photo is timestamped and geo-tagged.

whats_in_report.a: A 0–10 score, verdict (recommended / conditional / not recommended), list of critical and non-critical issues, repair cost estimate, photos of every problem, engine running video, and negotiation tips for the seller.

extra_fees.a: The standard inspection includes the 60-point check. Add-ons (dyno diagnostics, endoscope, paint tester) are itemised in the quote. Nothing is charged without your consent.

how_price_formed.a: Selection — fixed monthly fee. Inspection — fixed per-visit price depending on city and car type. The price is always shown before you confirm. No hidden fees.

payment_methods.a: Visa / Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA transfer (for EU). All payments go through Stripe, a secure acquirer. We don't accept cash.

when_charged.a: Selection: upon subscription start. Inspection: funds are reserved on confirmation and released to the inspector only after the report is uploaded. Until then it's held in escrow on our side.

data_privacy.a: We store only what's needed for selection and inspection: contacts, search criteria, reports. We never sell data to third parties. You can delete your account — data is wiped within 30 days (except records we must keep by law).

dispute.a: You have 72 hours to raise a dispute. Open it in the request chat → an independent second inspector re-checks the contested points free of charge. If the discrepancy is confirmed — full refund.
dispute.q: What if I disagree with the report?

guarantee.a: The truthfulness of the report: if within 30 days of purchase a hidden defect surfaces that the inspector should have caught, we refund the inspection fee and partially cover the repair per the contract terms.

refund.a: If the inspection didn't happen due to our fault — full refund within 3 business days to the same card. If due to your fault (you cancelled after the inspector was dispatched) — only the on-site call-out fee is retained, per city tariff.

agreement_flow.a: Your specialist sends 1–3 cars per day to your request chat. Each one has photos, price, key numbers and their note. You say "yes" — we contact the seller, schedule a viewing, and dispatch an inspector.
agreement_flow.q: How do we agree on a candidate?

duration_selection.a: On average 3–10 days to find the first candidate that passes our filters. Rare specs or unusual models can take up to 4 weeks. You see progress live in the app.

how_we_find.a: You set your criteria: make, model, budget, year, mileage, transmission, region. Our specialist monitors marketplaces 24/7 and sends you the top 3 candidates with a short note — what's good, what's a red flag. You decide which one to pursue.

pre_visit_checks.a: VIN history (CarVertical / Carfax style), odometer cross-check with service records, seller type (private / flipper / dealer), price vs market, photo analysis for signs of hidden issues. If something looks critical — we skip the listing.
pre_visit_checks.q: What's verified before the inspector visits?

sources.a: Germany: mobile.de, autoscout24, kleinanzeigen, dealer feeds. Austria: autoscout24.at, willhaben.at. Plus private listings and closed dealer networks from our partners.
sources.q: Where do you search for cars?

languages.a: English, German, Russian. The app interface and inspection reports are also available in all three languages.

response_time.a: Standard response time: under 6 hours during business hours (Mon–Sat 09:00–20:00 CET). Urgent issues on an active inspection are prioritised — under 1 hour.

where_chat.a: Profile → "Help & FAQ" → "Contact support". Or in any request — chat icon next to the status. Support replies in English, German and Russian.
where_chat.q: Where do I find support chat?
